title: Blocking someone you have written to asks first
steps: Launch with -UseFakeGmail (fake mail only); open Sent and note an address you wrote to, then open a conversation from that same address in the Inbox or All mail
In the toast press Cancel, then press Option-Command-B again and press Block anyway
expected: A toast says 'You've written to <address>. Block it anyway?' with Block anyway and Cancel, and nothing is saved until Block anyway. Cancel leaves no rule. The same question appears in Settings > Blocked when you type such an address and press Block. Sent mail is never moved or hidden by a block.
